title: Road Rash: 30th Anniversary Edition
provenance: Reported by pankaj-ug (highball-db#1391, 2026-11-22), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.28, engine x64-crossover26.3-r30, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes: with the steam recipe and no Steam id. The page carries the Steam release's id. Menu options take a while to load, and quitting the game is a problem, not described further. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: EA's digital release of Road Rash for its 30th anniversary, out on Steam in November 2026. Reported playable on a base M5 with DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r30 in a 5 minute session, with slow menus and trouble quitting.
